div.p: One Java 26+ JPMS service. Stateless except TOKTRAK_DATA_DIR. A single writer appends NDJSON; startup replays the in-memory projection.

ul.li: Container runs linked jlink runtime with JFR/JMX/jcmd diagnostics.
Reverse proxy owns TLS, compression, public port, and backups.
TOKTRAK_TOKEN_PEPPER hashes tracker tokens and must remain stable.

text.tspan: one platform thread per process, bounded queue
